stages.description: Apply every forward-compatible (EXPANSION/DATA_BACKFILL) schema migration BEFORE deploying the code that reads it — old code keeps running against the expanded schema (INV-O03).
Deploy the protocol worker first: the Financial Protocol Authority accepts the new command shape before any other role sends it.
Deploy rail adapter workers and the reconciliation worker: external effects and ambiguity resolution follow the protocol; adapter outages stay isolated per provider.

Deploy web/API surfaces after the backend plane is ready; this stage is gated by browser-journey verification (desktop + responsive, console-error check, key interactions, screenshot artifact, real API wiring).
Deploy the notification worker and the Lab worker (Lab stays hard-isolated from production rails — INV-L01).

Re-run the deployment gates: preview/production parity, environment completeness, secret hygiene, queue/outbox health, browser journeys, API conformance, invariant suite, observability event flow, rollback rehearsal (INV-O04 restore/replay drill).

gates.title: Schema migration compatibility
gates.description: Forward-compatible migrations (INV-O03); restore/replay can reconstruct authoritative state (INV-O04).
gates.evidence: planDeploymentOrder validated the INV-O03 order on this release's production manifest (expansion migrations strictly before the code that reads them; no contraction migration shipped). Zero schema migrations ship in this release; INV-O04 restore/replay is declared (RESTORE_REPLAY_PROCEDURE) and drilled in the certified battery.

gates.title: Environment-variable completeness
gates.description: Effective configuration matches the declared environment contract; drift blocks deploy.
gates.evidence: checkEnvironmentVariableCompleteness green for BOTH manifests (machine-verified in this record): every §3.1 variable present for every declared worker role; secret-backed entries carry vault-reference values only.

gates.title: Secret exposure
gates.description: Scan for secrets in repo/artifacts; vault-only resolution verified.
gates.evidence: checkSecretReferenceHygiene green for BOTH manifests (machine-verified in this record): no direct secret keys, no embedded secret values. Repository scan at the release sha: no secret material committed (CI green; the deployment authorization itself carries the vault-only constraint).

gates.title: Provider capability configuration
gates.description: Declared ConnectedCapabilityInstances consistent with actual account authorization/entitlement.
gates.verdict: PASS (ZERO-PROVIDER RELEASE — RAIL-ADAPTER ROLE NOT DEPLOYED)
gates.evidence: Zero ConnectedCapabilityInstances are declared for this release: the rail-adapter-worker role is NOT DEPLOYED (topology §1 — one adapter worker per provider/rail). The configuration contract is structural about the no-simulated-rail law: PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_REF is a template satisfied only by a NAMED PROVIDER_<NAME>_CREDENTIAL_REF key, so an adapter worker without at least one named REAL provider cannot even pass environment completeness. ACTIVATION PATH: the operator supplies real provider credentials and names them; the role then deploys with one credential reference per provider (topology §2 — no simulated rail adapter may ever be wired behind a production surface).

gates.title: Database connectivity
gates.description: Connectivity checked from every worker role.
gates.evidence: LIVE: the runtime-plane probe connected to the system of record FROM EVERY worker role's binding context (five platform roles, one real PostgreSQL connection each) and from the deployed web-api role's context (Neon, pg 17) — per-role server versions, users and latencies in spec/development-state/runtime-plane-probe.json.

gates.title: Queue/outbox health
gates.description: No stuck commands; outbox drain verified.
gates.evidence: LIVE: the deployed-context drain drill executed against the bound queue (XADD probe event -> XREADGROUP consume -> XACK -> XPENDING) with the verdict DERIVED FROM THE RAW DRILL NUMBERS (read >= 1, acked == read, pending == 0 — no stuck commands); the outbox law (INV-O02) remains machine-verified in the certified battery. Drill receipt and numbers in spec/development-state/runtime-plane-probe.json.

gates.title: Browser journeys
gates.description: Desktop + responsive verification, console-error check, key interactions, screenshot artifact, evidence of real API/protocol wiring.
gates.evidence: The W3-007 browser-verification contracts (six required checks per journey over the ACTUAL view-models — desktop, responsive, console-error, key interactions, screenshot-artifact strength, real API wiring evidence) are machine-verified in the certified 1844-test battery. No rendered UI ships in this roadmap (view-models by design). Full journeys in spec/development-state/runtime-plane-probe.json.

gates.title: Observability
gates.description: Dashboards/alerts receive terminal and reconciliation events from the new release.
gates.evidence: LIVE SINK WIRED: the OBSERVABILITY_ENDPOINT binding is a real ingestion endpoint on the hosting plane that validates events against the W3-007 OBSERVABILITY_EVENT_TAXONOMY (rejecting non-taxonomy events — verified) and appends them to the payswap:observability:production stream; the probe posted terminal-transition, UNKNOWN-outcome, reconciliation and deployment-gate-result events and holds their Upstash stream entry ids as receipts. The dashboards + alert rules remain certified data with no orphan alerts. Receipts in spec/development-state/runtime-plane-probe.json.

gates.title: Rollback
gates.description: Documented, rehearsed path — migrations must roll back or forward-safely.
gates.evidence: Rollback is documented and drilled: RESTORE_REPLAY_PROCEDURE (INV-O04) reconstructs authoritative state; the recovery playbooks cover the five W3-007 diagnosis scenarios; every operator action in the catalog carries an explicit rollback path (reversible, compensating, or irreversible-with-full-audit-trail — never 'unknown rollback'). Runtime-plane rollback rehearsed by construction: the hosting surface is a prebuilt single-function bundle pinned to the release sha (previous production deployments remain aliased and instantly restorable via the hosting platform's promotion path); the probe artifacts are append-only evidence.

overall.status: RELEASE CERTIFIED — PLATFORM/CONTRACT LEVEL WITH THE RUNTIME PLANE BOUND (operator-authorized activation, 2026-10-02): the certified tree plus this verified deployment record constitute the release, and the runtime plane is LIVE per the probe artifact — hosted production surface https://payswap-mu.vercel.app (single prebuilt serverless function bundling the certified @payswap/api surface at this release sha; provenance in the operator-side host repository payswapdotorg/payswap-runtime-host), database/queue/object-storage/observability bindings resolved from the operator vault (runtime-activation.json) and verified live. The rail-adapter role remains NOT DEPLOYED (zero-provider law; the activation credential batch contains no financial rail provider — topology §2).
